question_cn: 开局中为什么要避免重复移动同一个棋子？
question_en: Why should you avoid moving the same piece repeatedly in the opening?

options.text_cn: 重复移动会让棋子位置变差
options.text_en: Repeated moves always worsen the piece's position.

options.text_cn: 每次重复走同一棋子，等于让对方免费多出一个新棋子，对方积累发展优势
options.text_en: Each extra move with the same piece gives the opponent time to develop another piece and build a lead.

options.text_cn: 规则不允许连续两步走同一棋子
options.text_en: The rules prohibit moving the same piece on consecutive turns.

options.text_cn: 重复走子会让王暴露在危险中
options.text_en: Repeated moves expose the king to danger.

explanation_cn: 开局的核心原则是「每步出一个新棋子」。若你走了马到f3，下一步再把马从f3挪走，等于这两步只出了一个棋子，而对方两步可以出两个棋子——对方在发展上领先一子。这种「节奏损失」（tempo loss）会在开局中积累，让对方获得主动权。
explanation_en: A useful opening principle is to develop a new piece with each move. If you play a knight to f3 and then move it again, you have developed only one piece in two moves while the opponent may develop two. This loss of tempo can accumulate and give the opponent the initiative.
